content.value_statement: Building reliable AI skills is hard when instructions, resources, and packaging rules are unclear. This skill gives a structured process for concise SKILL.md files, reusable resources, validation, and iteration.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md structure and frontmatter fields.
Defines when to use scripts, references, and assets in a skill.
Guides progressive disclosure for large or variant-specific knowledge.
Provides a six-step process from examples to packaging and iteration.
Recommends validation and testing steps for bundled scripts and packages.
limitations: It does not include the referenced init or packaging scripts in this package.
It does not create files by itself; an agent must edit the workspace.
It does not replace human review of security, licensing, or marketplace policy.
It provides general guidance, not domain-specific templates for every field.

use_cases.title: Design a New Skill
use_cases.description: Turn a task idea into a clear skill plan with triggers, workflows, and reusable resources.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Review a current skill for bloated instructions, missing references, and unclear resource organization.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Package
use_cases.description: Check that a skill has focused content, tested resources, and a clear path to packaging.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill-creator guidance to design a new skill for [task]. Ask only the most important questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these example requests: [examples]. Identify which scripts, references, or assets should be included in the skill.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this existing skill for concise instructions, clear triggers, useful resources, and avoidable extra files.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Domain Skill Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a skill that supports these domains: [domains]. Keep SKILL.md concise and route detailed guidance into references.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing invoices before payment approval.
output: A focused skill purpose and trigger description.
A short workflow for invoice checks and exception handling.
Suggested references for policies, vendor rules, and approval thresholds.

output_examples.input: Improve a skill whose SKILL.md is too long and covers three unrelated domains.
output: A smaller core instruction file with clear navigation.
Separate reference files for each domain.
A list of duplicate or low-value content to remove.

output_examples.input: Prepare a completed skill for marketplace publication.
output: A packaging checklist focused on required metadata and file structure.
Testing notes for any bundled scripts.
Review reminders for licensing, security, and unnecessary files.

best_practices: Start from concrete user examples before writing the skill body.
Keep core instructions in SKILL.md and move detailed references to linked files.
Test bundled scripts before packaging the skill for distribution.
anti_patterns: Do not add broad documentation files that the agent does not need.
Do not hide trigger conditions in the body instead of the frontmatter description.
Do not place large reference content directly in SKILL.md when a linked file is clearer.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI skills with clear triggers, concise instructions, and useful supporting resources.

faq.question: Can it update an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for revising SKILL.md, reorganizing resources, and iterating after real use.

faq.question: Does it include working scripts?
faq.answer: No. The audited package only includes SKILL.md, so referenced helper scripts are guidance examples.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How should references be organized?
faq.answer: Keep SKILL.md concise and place detailed domain or format guidance in directly linked reference files.

faq.question: Is this a security auditing skill?
faq.answer: No. It gives skill design guidance and still requires normal security and policy review before publishing.
